name: FLA_SYSTEM_OPTIONS_ALL
description: FLA_SYSTEM_OPTIONS_ALL contains setup options at the operating unit level. There is one row for each operating unit. It retains information such as the operating unit's ledger, interest calculation method, and inventory item master org and so on.

columns.name: SYSTEM_OPTION_ID
columns.description: System setup option identifier. This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier as defined in general ledger.

columns.name: PRIMARY_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Primary regime code. This drives the accounting model and reporting for the lease in the primary ledger.

columns.name: SECONDARY_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Optional secondary regime code. The value selected should be different from what is selected as primary regime code.

columns.name: CALENDAR_ID
columns.description: Calendar identifier from General Ledger Calendars. This is used for schedules calculations purpose.

columns.name: DEFAULT_CURRENCY_CONV_TYPE
columns.description: Default currency conversion type which should be used for the leases.

columns.name: INTEREST_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Interest method. Possible values are DAILY COMPOUND, LINEAR COMPOUND, or SIMPLE INTEREST.

columns.name: AMORTIZATION_FREQUENCY_CODE
columns.description: Frequency at which the amortization is calculated. Possible values are DAILY and PERIODICALLY.

columns.name: INVENTORY_MASTER_ORG_ID
columns.description: Inventory item master operating unit identifier.

columns.name: AUTO_LEASE_NUMBER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the lease number is automatically generated or not.

columns.name: AUTO_ASSET_NUMBER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the asset number is automatically generated or not.

columns.name: AUTO_PAYMENT_TERM_NUMBER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the payment term number is automatically generated or not.

columns.name: AUTO_OPTION_NUMBER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the options number is automatically generated or not.

columns.name: CONSOLIDATE_ADJ_ITEMS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the adjustments should be consolidated into one item or not.

columns.name: SECONDARY_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identification as defined in general ledger. This will carry the Secondary Ledger and used for secondary regime accounting.

columns.name: AP_INTEGRATION_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the integration to Oracle Payables is enabled for the Business unit or not.

columns.name: LEASE_TRX_APPROVAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the lease approval is enabled for the business unit.

columns.name: LEASE_IMPORT_APPROVAL_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the option for approval during import of lease data.

columns.name: ALLOW_PROPERTY_DEFINITION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the property definition is allowed for the leases.

columns.name: LIABILITY_RECLASS_FLAG
columns.description: The flag indicates whether reclassification of liability needs to be done.

columns.name: LIABILITY_RECLASS_FROM_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the liability reclassification is processed.

columns.name: ENABLE_REVENUE_LEASES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates revenue leases are enabled for the business unit.

columns.name: ENABLE_OPTIONS_REV_AMORT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the revenue amortization is applicable for options.

columns.name: AR_INTEGRATION_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the integration to Oracle Receivables is enabled for the Business unit.

columns.name: ENABLE_EXP_PROPERTY_VAL_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the property validations need to be executed when the expense lease is validated.

columns.name: ENABLE_REV_PROPERTY_VAL_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the property validations need to be executed when the revenue lease is validated.

columns.name: PRIM_PROP_SCOPE_CHANGE_CODE
columns.description: Scope change method for leases with asset classification as property in primary accounting standard. Values can be Unit based percentage and Liability based percentage.

columns.name: SECD_PROP_SCOPE_CHANGE_CODE
columns.description: Scope change method for leases with asset classification as property in secondary accounting standard. Values can be Unit based percentage and Liability based percentage.

columns.name: PRIM_EQUIP_SCOPE_CHANGE_CODE
columns.description: Scope change method for leases with asset classification as equipment in primary accounting standard. Values can be Unit based percentage and Liability based percentage.

columns.name: SECD_EQUIP_SCOPE_CHANGE_CODE
columns.description: Scope change method for leases with asset classification as equipment in secondary accounting standard. Values can be Unit based percentage and Liability based percentage.

columns.name: LIABILITY_RECLASS_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Liability reclassification method. Values can be long term liability balance and long term liability balance and present value of payments.

columns.name: REQUIRE_PROPERTY_DEFN_CODE
columns.description: Indicates if the property association for expense leases is mandatory at the business unit level. Possible values are Mandatory and Optional.

columns.name: TAX_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Tax Driver: Tax classification code for payment term.

columns.name: PRIMARY_INTENDED_USE_CODE
columns.description: Tax Driver: The purpose for which a product may be used. The actual use is stored at the distribution level.

columns.name: PRODUCT_CATEGORY
columns.description: Tax Driver: Identifies the taxable nature of a noninventory based item for tax determination or tax reporting.

columns.name: PRODUCT_FISCAL_CLASSIFICATION
columns.description: Tax Driver: Product fiscal classification

columns.name: PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.description: Tax Driver: Type of product. Possible values are Goods and Services. This value defaults from Inventory Item attributes or is entered by the user.

columns.name: TRX_BUSINESS_CATEGORY
columns.description: Tax Driver: Transactions category assigned by user.

columns.name: USER_DEFINED_FISCAL_CLASS
columns.description: Tax Driver: Fiscal Classification.

columns.name: WITHHOLDING_TAX_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Tax Driver: Withholding tax group identifier.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_SUB_TYPE
columns.description: Tax Driver: Classification used by a tax authority to categorize a document associated with a transaction for a tax.

columns.name: FIRST_PTY_REG_ID
columns.description: Tax Driver: Deploying company's Tax Registration number

columns.name: THIRD_PTY_REG_ID
columns.description: Tax Driver: Bill-to Customer Tax Registration Number

columns.name: TAX_INCLUDED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether tax is included or not.

columns.name: UPFRONT_TAX_APPLICABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether upfront tax is applicable or not.

columns.name: ENABLE_SUBLEASES_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether subleases are allowed or not.

columns.name: ARREARS_PAY_DT_TREATMENT_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the payment due date is included in day count calculation for the present value derivation when the payment is in arrears. Possible values are Beginning of the day and End of the day.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
